title: Operation Shaban Militant Death Toll Surpasses 100
detail: The militant death toll in Operation Shaban surpassed 100, with security sources reporting 64 militants killed directly under the operation and 102 in total when combined with other intelligence-based operations conducted since the July 5 launch. The latest 24-hour period alone accounted for 16 militant deaths as the Pakistan Army, Frontier Corps, and Balochistan Police continued coordinated ground assaults backed by aerial operations against Tehreek-i-Taliban Pakistan ('Fitna al-Khawarij') hideouts across the province's mountainous terrain.

media.caption: Security forces continue Operation Shaban clearance operations against TTP militants in Balochistan
